text: The project features concessional IDA financing of US$125 million with a 25-year maturity and a 5-year grace period. It adopts an integrated approach combining infrastructure development and institutional capacity building. The project demonstrated operational agility during the COVID-19 pandemic by incorporating health-related procurement. It aligns with Pakistan's disaster risk management framework and climate adaptation agenda.

metadata.solution_name: Disaster and Climate Resilience Improvement Project (DCRIP)
